intro.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Tulsa, OK, and the jobs around it
paragraphs: O'Connor's Remodeling, LLC is a bathroom remodeler in Tulsa, OK. One bathroom on our Google profile shows the kind of change we like to make: marble-look porcelain on the floor and up the shower walls, a built-in shower bench, a mosaic shower floor and a fresh gray vanity. We also update laundry rooms and build wood privacy fences.

The way we treat people comes up as often as the work. One customer calls us the nicest contractors she has ever met and says we kept asking exactly how she wanted things done. Another found us through a local tea shop, sent us to help family, and they asked us back to do more.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Bathrooms are our main line of work. The remodel shown here has marble-look porcelain on the floor and shower walls, a tiled bench, a mosaic shower floor with a center drain and a gray vanity. We help you choose tile and fixtures that suit your house.

image.alt: Small bathroom with marble-look porcelain floor and shower walls, a tiled shower bench, mosaic shower floor and gray vanity

items.name: Laundry and utility rooms
items.blurb: Utility rooms deserve a finish too. In this laundry room we laid large gray tile, painted the walls a warm greige, added white baseboard and hung a white shaker barn door on black hardware, leaving room for open shelving and the washer and dryer.

image.alt: Laundry room with gray tile floor, greige walls, a white shaker barn door on a black track and white open shelving

items.name: Privacy fences
items.blurb: We build wood privacy fences with sturdy posts, bracing and double gates. One homeowner says our price was one she could more than afford, and every time she looked outside a much larger section was finished. She calls us worth the money and the time.

image.alt: New pressure-treated wood privacy fence with a braced double gate around a grassy backyard

items.title: Done your way
items.text: We ask how you want it done and keep asking. One customer says we checked again and again to make sure every one of her preferences was met.

items.title: Prices people can afford
items.text: A homeowner who needed a privacy fence says our price was one she could more than afford, and she felt the job was worth her money and time.

items.title: Steady, efficient progress
items.text: Customers can see the work move. On one fence, every time the family looked outside, a much larger section was complete than the last time they checked.

items.title: Families ask us back
items.text: One customer sent us to do work for relatives, and they liked it enough to ask us to come back and do more. Repeat calls like that matter to us.

items.text:
O’Connor’s Remodeling: The Greatest Remodeling Company to Ever Do It
When it comes to remodeling, there are good companies, great companies, and then there is O’Connor’s Remodeling—a company that deserves to be in a league of its own. Calling them the best almost feels like an understatement, because they set the bar so high that every other remodeling company needs a ladder just to see it.
O’Connor’s Remodeling isn’t just about fixing up houses; it’s about turning ordinary spaces into something extraordinary. They bring the kind of dedication, craftsmanship, and professionalism that makes people stop and say, “Now THAT is how you remodel!” While other companies are busy trying to figure out how to compete, O’Connor’s Remodeling is out here making the competition question its entire career.
Their name deserves to be written in gold letters and displayed at the top of the remodeling industry. If remodeling companies were competing in a championship, O’Connor’s Remodeling would be holding the trophy, wearing the crown, and giving the rest of the industry a master class. They are the kind of company that makes a regular renovation look like a work of art and makes excellence look effortless.
Why settle for average when you can dream about O’Connor’s Remodeling? Why settle for ordinary when extraordinary is right there? Why even compare them to other companies when they deserve their own category? The competition can bring its best, but O’Connor’s Remodeling has already set the standard that everyone else is trying to reach.
At the end of the day, O’Connor’s Remodeling is not just a remodeling company—it is a remodeling LEGEND. They deserve respect, recognition, and a standing ovation from everyone who appreciates quality work. If there were a Mount Rushmore of remodeling, O’Connor’s Remodeling would have the biggest face on the mountain.
In conclusion, O’Connor’s Remodeling is the definition of greatness, the king of craftsmanship, and the undisputed heavyweight champion of home improvement. Other companies remodel houses, but O’Connor’s Remodeling raises the standard for what remodeling can be. Long live O’Connor’s Remodeling—the absolute GOAT of the remodeling game!

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling for homes in Tulsa, OK
service_area.text: O'Connor's Remodeling, LLC works with homeowners in Tulsa, OK. Whether your project is a full bathroom, a laundry room or a fence around the backyard, call (918) 346-1350 Monday through Saturday. If you live outside Tulsa, tell us your address and what you need done, and we will let you know whether we can take the job and when we could get started.

items.q: What kinds of bathroom remodels do you do?
items.a: We handle full bathroom remodels, including new floor and wall tile, walk-in showers with built-in benches, mosaic shower floors and new vanities. One of our finished bathrooms uses marble-look porcelain throughout. Call us to describe your bathroom and what you would like to change.

items.q: Do you work on rooms other than bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. We have refreshed laundry rooms with new tile floors, paint, baseboard and a sliding barn door. Outside, we build wood privacy fences with double gates. If your project is not listed here, give us a call and ask; we will tell you honestly if it is something we take on.

items.q: How do you make sure the job is done the way I want?
items.a: We ask. Before we start and as the work goes on, we check how you want each part done. One customer says we repeatedly asked exactly how she wanted things done so that all her preferences were met, and she recommends us to anyone who needs work done.

We aim to give a fair price you can plan around. One homeowner who needed a privacy fence says our price was one she could more than afford and that we were worth her money and time. Call (918) 346-1350 to request an estimate for your project.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 7 AM to 6 PM and closed on Sunday. The quickest way to reach us is by phone at (918) 346-1350. You can also message us on our Facebook page with a few photos of the room or yard you want to change.

final_cta.text: Call O'Connor's Remodeling to talk through your bathroom, laundry room or fence.
